title: The Vision Wormhole: Latent-Space Communication in Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Systems
authors: Xiaoze Liu; Ruowang Zhang; Weichen Yu; Siheng Xiong; Liu He; Feijie Wu; Hoin Jung; Matt Fredrikson; Xiaoqian Wang; Jing Gao
affiliations: Purdue University, Contextual AI, Carnegie Mellon University, Georgia Institute of Technology

problem_statement.en: Text-mediated multi-agent systems incur substantial runtime overhead and information quantization loss, while existing latent-state transfer either assumes homogeneous agents or requires pair-specific translators that scale quadratically across heterogeneous model families.
problem_statement.zh: 以離散文字為媒介的多 agent 系統會產生顯著 runtime 開銷與資訊量化損失；既有 latent-state transfer 方法則假設 agent 同質，或依賴隨異質模型家族數量呈二次成長的 pair-specific translator。

key_innovation.en: Vision Wormhole uses a per-family Universal Visual Codec to compress a sender's latent reasoning trace into a shared reference space, then decodes it as a residual perturbation in the receiver's native vision-token span. Its hub-and-spoke affine alignment reduces multi-family integration complexity from O(N²) pairwise translators to O(N) per-model mappings.
key_innovation.zh: Vision Wormhole 以 per-family Universal Visual Codec 將 sender 的 latent reasoning trace 壓縮至共享 reference space，再解碼為 receiver 原生 vision-token span 中的 residual perturbation。其 hub-and-spoke affine alignment 將多模型家族的整合複雜度由 O(N²) 個 pairwise translator 降至 O(N) 個 per-model mapping。

baselines_compared: TextMAS, LatentMAS-Hybrid, OCR image relay, Single-agent VLM

key_improvements.en: In the main heterogeneous MAS results, Vision Wormhole improves accuracy by up to 26.2 percentage points and provides up to 5.47x wall-clock speedup over TextMAS; it reduces end-to-end runtime in most evaluated settings and yields positive macro-average Δ-accuracy.
key_improvements.zh: 在主要異質 MAS 結果中，Vision Wormhole 相較 TextMAS 的 accuracy 最高提升 26.2 個百分點，wall-clock speedup 最高達 5.47x；多數評測設定的 end-to-end runtime 均縮短，且 macro-average Δ-accuracy 為正。

gpu_count: 1x NVIDIA RTX A6000 (two-backbone runs); 2x NVIDIA RTX A6000 (four-backbone pool)

reuse_metric.en: No explicit reuse rate is reported; across nine reasoning benchmarks, the latent channel yields positive macro-average Δ-accuracy and reduces wall-clock time in most heterogeneous settings.
reuse_metric.zh: 論文未報告明確的 reuse rate；在九項 reasoning benchmark 上，latent channel 的 macro-average Δ-accuracy 為正，且在多數異質設定中縮短 wall-clock time。
